Disturbing news has reached us from Bubonic Plague, as a new epidemic seems to have taken root. A certain Mediterranean merchant fleet that encountered it apparently made the following report:

Alas! our ships enter the port, but of a thousand sailors hardly ten are spared. We reach our homes; our kindred and our neighbors come from all parts to visit us. Woe to us for we cast at them the darts of death! Whilst we spoke to them, whilst they embraced us and kissed us, we scattered the poison from our lips. Going back to their homes, they in turn soon infected their whole families, who in three days succumbed, and were buried in one common grave. Priests and doctors visiting the sick returned from their duties ill, and soon were numbered with the dead. O death! cruel, bitter, impious death! which thus breaks the bonds of affection and divides father and mother, brother and sister, husband and wife. Lamenting our misery, we feared to fly, yet we dared not remain.

Naturally, guilds wield great power over the economy. Generally, they are a positive force for society, providing the public with confidence in products, ensuring the market remains stable, and controlling the growth of competition, among other things. Now that plague has seeped into our nation, spreading throughout the land, it is more important than ever that guilds ensure that prices remain stable and work continues to be supplied.

However, to ensure this, guilds have been controlling wages, keeping them as they have always been in spite of the labor shortage caused by the death around us. Many guild members have become greatly disgruntled, knowing that they could be earning more, but would be crushed by the guild if they went independent. desc:
The hallowed halls of the College Royal in Paris echoed with anticipation as John Calvin, a young and passionate scholar, prepared to deliver a speech that would leave an indelible mark on the religious landscape of Europe. Little did he know that his words would ignite a firestorm of controversy, ultimately leading to his own banishment from the city he once called home.

As Calvin's powerful oration reverberated through the lecture hall, his fervent beliefs clashed with the entrenched doctrines of the Catholic Church. His eloquent arguments, steeped in a vision of religious reform, struck a chord with the eager audience and stirred unease among the establishment.

News of Calvin's speech spread like wildfire, reaching the ears of influential figures within the Church hierarchy. The esteemed scholars of the College Royal found themselves forced to condemn him as a heretic, a dangerous threat to the established order.
entities.name: The Need for Reform

options.name: What reasons did he have?

desc:
In the quiet corridors of Basel, a groundbreaking work emerges from the diligent pen of John Calvin. Its words, meticulously crafted and steeped in theological insight, are destined to reshape the religious landscape and ignite the fires of reform across Europe. The publication of Institutio Christianae Religionis marks a pivotal moment in the life of Calvin and the broader Protestant movement.

Within the pages of this weighty tome lies a comprehensive exposition of Calvin's religious beliefs and his vision for the reform of Christianity. Institutio Christianae Religionis embodies the essence of Calvin's teachings, offering a systematic framework for understanding the true nature of faith, salvation, and the relationship between God and humanity.

News of the publication spreads like wildfire, captivating the minds of scholars and religious leaders throughout Europe. The Catholic Church, deeply entrenched in its traditional doctrines, views this work with apprehension, recognizing it as a formidable challenge to its authority.

Calvin's magnum opus finds its way into the hands of both fervent supporters and staunch opponents. To some, it becomes a beacon of hope, illuminating a path towards a purer expression of Christian faith. To others, it represents a dangerous departure from established orthodoxy, an incendiary assault on the very foundations of the Church.
entities.name: John Calvin in Basel

options.name: With a lot of Sermons on Deuteronomy!

desc:
In the picturesque city of Geneve, a new era of religious fervor dawns as John Calvin takes up the mantle of spiritual leadership. His arrival marks the beginning of a transformative period that will shape the destiny of both the city and the Protestant Reformation.

Calvin, renowned for his intellectual prowess and unwavering devotion to reform, brings with him a vision of religious renewal. Guided by his belief in predestination and the sovereignty of God, he seeks to establish a community of devout believers, governed by biblical principles and a disciplined way of life.

As Calvin assumes his role as minister, the city of Geneva becomes a crucible for reform, attracting like-minded individuals and those seeking refuge from religious persecution. The Reformation takes root, and the city becomes a bastion of Protestant thought and practice.

Under Calvin's leadership, a system of Church governance is established, centered around the Consistory, a council composed of ministers and elders. This council ensures adherence to Calvin's strict moral code, leading to a transformative influence on all aspects of daily life, from personal behavior to public policies.

Geneva becomes a hub of theological education and a magnet for aspiring ministers, who flock to the city to learn from Calvin's teachings. His influential work, such as his Institutes of the Christian Religion, serves as a guide for believers and a blueprint for Protestant theology.

The effects of Calvin's ministry ripple beyond Geneva's borders, inspiring reform movements across Europe. His writings and teachings spread far and wide, gaining traction among those seeking a purer expression of faith.
entities.name: Calvin's Ministry in Geneva

Driven by a longing for a purer expression of faith and a rejection of the established religious order, our nation has become a fertile ground for the dissemination of Calvinist ideas. Calvin's theological teachings, centered around predestination, the sovereignty of God, and the authority of Scripture, resonate deeply with the disillusioned faithful seeking a transformative religious experience.

As these fervent ideas take hold, pockets of believers emerge, gathering in secret to discuss and study Calvin's works, such as his influential Institutes of the Christian Religion. These clandestine meetings serve as a breeding ground for passionate discussions, theological debates, and a sense of community among those who embrace the Calvinist doctrine.

The growing popularity of Calvinism poses a profound challenge to the traditional religious establishment. The Catholic Church, deeply entrenched in centuries-old dogma, faces the daunting task of reconciling its authority with the fervor of the Calvinist movement.

desc: Trading within our our Country has always maintained a standard currency, unified and supported by the might of our army and banner. However, as our authority wanes and our prestige fades, so does the strength of our coin. The shortage of Silver, precious stones, and the necessary materials to craft official currency has led to shortages and general dismay among the public. Many settlements have resulted in using barter agreements and completely negating the rule of law that we have set up...
entities.name: Currency Loses Value

effects: Add Country Modifier: Dlh Restored Authority Modifier (20 years)
options.name: We are reborn...

desc: Our people are no strangers to adversity. Through years of hardships, the ebb and flow of our power, and the restoration of the once great people, we have stood the test of time, emerging victorious and stronger than ever. Those who once opposed us will soon feel the full wrath of the mighty our Country army and our name will once again shake the foundations of India.
entities.name: Surviving the Aftermath

options.name: Sacrifice the ruling family!

desc: Despite the efforts of our priests, our Country do not seem pleased, and great catastrophes are coming to our realm. Should we want to survive the end of this cycle and move into a new more prosperous one, we must be willing to sacrifice whatever it takes. Gods are waiting for our blood offerings.
entities.name: Doom!

options.name: The need for a new our Country goes before the need for absolution.
The path she walks is the Devil's.

The temptation is becoming too much for Ruler Char to bear, but in the end, only fate can decide whether Ruler Char will have to seek forgiveness for more than thoughts this Sunday.
entities.name: Carnal Sins

options.name: Sorrow overtakes the our Country.

trigger: has character modifier: blessed talisman modifier

desc: Heir Char body has been draped, by whom none know, in a white cloth now stained red by Heir Char lost vitae. They say Heir Char was found by Heir Char horse, in a clearing in the woods. We know the place they speak of. Heir Char face is calm, almost serene. The courtiers reach out to touch. The terrible reality of the situation dawns on all. The cold felt by all is that of death.
entities.name: Hunting Accident

After some investigation, an answer is finally obtained from a chambermaid. It appears that Heir Char has been running about town in a most unchristian fashion, and that the our Country family is now becoming the laughing stock of our Country.
entities.name: Family Secret?

options.name: Use it to strengthen the throne.
Publish the knowledge abroad.

desc: Twilight is always horrid. The clouds racing circles across moonless skies, cruel stars suspended like grains of broken glass, and chandeliers throwing strange shadows across the our Country chambers. Lately, a strange sense has come upon the our Country that there is something wrong with the place. The geometry of it seems... unsound. Thinking back... it all started with the birth of Heir Char.
entities.name: Fear and Loathing in our Country

effects: Add Religious Influence: Religious Influence Mild Bonus
options.name: One must find solace in the arms of the Lord.

desc: A strange fever has claimed the life of the our Country's beloved our Country. As the our Country sheds its clothes for blacker garments, it strikes all what a frail and transient thing life can be.
entities.name: A Beloved our Country Dies

options.name: Heeere's Game Concept Ruler Char!
Horrific.

desc:
The our Country senses instantly that there is something wrong in the attendant's voice as she meekly inquires about a strange wall in the our Country castle. There is something in her voice, right below the surface. Hidden contempt, and fear.

Ruler Char remembers it clearly now. How small the body felt. Carrying it down into the damp cellar, laying the bricks. It made Ruler Char sick. Sick to the core. Killing Ruler Char progeny was not the catharsis Ruler Char had expected it to be. For an instant, the flashing glimpse of an insight blows across Ruler Char mind...
entities.name: The Discovery

effects: Add Country Modifier: Relief From (10 years)
options.name: Game Concept Ruler Char would give Game Concept Ruler Char god-damned soul for just a glass of beer.
Not by the hair of Game Concept Ruler Char chinny-chin-chin!

desc: To the our Country, the our Country chamber is a swirling mist of scents and shapes, coming and going into and out of existence like colorful snowflakes. Ruler Char is hungry. So very hungry. As if Ruler Char had not eaten in months. The stars looking down on Ruler Char, still suspended in a moonless sky, laugh and dance. They seem free, and wild. There is something about those stars. They seem so... right. Ruler Char has gone quite insane.
entities.name: Danse Macabre

options.name: Nature always finds its course.
Propose a game of chess on the veranda.

desc: Again Advisor Char interrupts, Advisor Char furrowed brow telling tall tales of concern and sleepless nights. On and on Advisor Char goes concerning those frivolous matters of 'heirs' and 'stable successions'. This dusty old study and the advisor's dry voice resonating of boredom and wasted potential accentuates the brightness of the clear day outside. Does Advisor Char ever stop? There is nothing that could convince Bachelor Char that marriage is preferable to the promise of a clear sky. After all, in nature, the first step leading an animal into the grave is always procreation.
entities.name: Wedding Bells

options.name: Indeed we shall!
We have better things to do.

desc: While it is not uncommon among a certain type of Bachelor Char to wish to remain outside the inevitable bonds of wedlock, the bonds are inevitable nevertheless. Looking out from the our Country's perch, Ruler Char spots Ruler Char prey. Bachelor Char of Bachelor Char has for a long time been postponing Bachelor Char marriage, and Bachelor Char throne lacks a secure succession. This might be the perfect time to form a dynastic bond between our countries. It might be in our interest to dispatch an embassy to try to marry our own Bachelorette Char into this foreign Bachelor Country house.
entities.name: A Modest Proposal

effects: Reverse Add Opinion: Opinion Dynastic Love
options.name: There could be no finer candidate.

options.name: What is this foul witchcraft? Begone!

Bachelorette Char eyes are extravagant, Bachelorette Char hair is incredible, and the our Country's eyes are drawn to the painting as if to a vacuum. A cunning smile finds its way to an advisor's face. The noise of the room dies down. Bachelor Char does not know how long Bachelor Char stands there looking at Bachelorette Country beauty.
entities.name: A Rose from a Foreign Land

effects: Reverse Add Opinion: Opinion Dynastic United
options.name: A good Game Concept Bachelorette Country woman, no doubt.

options.name: This will obviously not do.

Bachelorette Country of Bachelorette Country has offered her hand in marriage, and the our Country is not sure if he should laugh or feel insulted. Then again, there is the succession to consider.
entities.name: A Thorn from a Foreign Land

True, mistakes were made during recent conflicts, but they were all hardly the fault of the our Country. Besides, the our Country also commanded troops. desc: The garden is bathed in the cool light of a full moon. Turning a corner to come across this sight was not what Target Ruler had expected, but here it is. Before Target Ruler stands a monument to one of our former wars. The beauty lies not in the exquisite marble, or even in the craftsmanship of the thing, but in the fact that even now, many years later, the monument is still strewn with thousands and thousands of fresh flowers. Here, if nowhere else, the memory of our past, and the memories of the fallen, still lives.

entities.name: The Weeping Song

Spring is in the air, and as Ruler Char leans in toward her, with the intoxicating scent of her perfume painfully present, a thought crosses Ruler Char mind.
entities.name: A Silent Spring

Regale one of the lords with a childhood story.

desc: The chandeliers blaze shadows and light across the grand ballroom of the our Country palace, and the music of a hundred dancing Our Country fills the air. The foreign guests and local dignitaries greet Ruler Char with jubilation. Everywhere is conversation, laughter, discussion, and the breathing, pulsating rhythm of life. The our Country's eyes gaze across the assembled myriads, contemplating whom Ruler Char should talk to tonight.

desc: Suddenly, something startles the animal, and before the our Country has time to fire, it is long gone. Ruler Char looks around. The water in the small creek reflects the sunlight of a perfect day, and the reeds wave slowly before a light breeze. Is that laughter? Ruler Char realizes now what had startled the animal. In a cradle, floating among the reeds, lies a laughing little boy. Judging by his smile, one would say that he has never known fear in his life.

The air is filled with the smells of roasted almonds, horses, and intrigue. our Country cultural and military prominence are truly great boons, and nowhere is this fact more real than here today.

desc:
Espionage may be the hardest test there is for loyalty to one's country. Both fear and temptations surround spies constantly, and the better they are at what they do, the more certain they are to face them. These temptations, of course, are something we are more than willing to provide foreign agents.

An agent from Espionage Event Country, a country where corruption is rampant, has recently decided to give in to one of these temptations. Eager to make a bigger profit than most can hope to earn through bribes, he has offered to act as a double agent for us. However, the 'anonymous' method of contact he chose has turned out to be less anonymous than expected, so we now know his name. How shall we proceed?
entities.name: Half the Loyalty, Double the Agent

desc:
Once arrested and removed from the comfort of his station, the ambassador we suspected of being complicit in espionage quickly admitted his guilt under interrogation. What's more, his confession indicates the spy network he was part of was more far-reaching than previously suspected. While this is certainly an embarrassment for Spying Ambassador, they are requesting we resolve the situation amicably by sending the ambassador home immediately.

While it is good praxis not to kill or imprison diplomats when it can be avoided, this man has proven himself to be an enemy of our nation. More importantly, he could still have information that is of value to us. Should we let him go to smooth over the situation?
entities.name: Ambassador Confesses

options.name: He'll be even more valuable to us now.

desc:
We are more than aware of the corruption plaguing our Country society, but we had at least hoped that it did not go beyond money changing hands between our own citizens. We were wrong. Associates of an agent maintaining our spy network in Origin Country have proven recently that he has accepted a sum of money that could only have come from the Origin Country government. We have to accept that one of our best was not as loyal as we hoped.

Some say that this operation may be salvaged yet. If confronted with evidence of his betrayal, he might be ready to switch back to his original allegiance - with the added benefit of having the trust of the Origin Country. Is it worth the risk?
entities.name: Second Chance for a Traitor

The difficult thing about relying on people of low character is that they have rarely been swayed for the last time. The Espionage Event Country spy we offered a large sum of money and our mercy for turning double agent against his country seems to have been discovered by those he betrayed. Our other spies report that he was offered to continue working for both nations, but with his true allegiance shifted back to his home country.

That the offer has been made, there can be no doubt about. His coming out of it alive means he must have, at the very least, pretended to accept. Despite this, he may still be working for us and could only be handing token information to the enemy. Can we afford to take our chances?

Religious institutions are considered sacrosanct and above the petty plots and schemes of countries and spies. This is why it is crucial to infiltrate them. Many secrets that would never be spoken aloud are told in confidence to religious authorities, which the practice of confession has even turned into an institution.

A church in Victim Country, a country on which we have focused our espionage efforts, has presented an unprecedented opportunity to exploit this. One of our loyal agents, posing as a nun in a local convent, has found that she can overhear the conversations from confessionals while doing chores in the church. While she is likely to escape detection, the plan would outrage religious authorities if discovered. Is it worth taking our chances?

desc:
Our plan to use information from confessionals to improve our intelligence gathering in Victim Country has resulted in a diplomatic disaster with the Papacy, as our agent was discovered a few months into the operation. Facing the wrath of the Church, she has since disappeared from the convent along with her belongings; whether this is her own doing or the actions of the enemy, we may never know.

We can be certain, however, that the Church found out enough to realize we were behind what happened. The Pope is shocked that we would exploit the Church and its practices in this way. The our Country enjoys some plausible deniability, but the country's standing is still irreversibly harmed.

desc:
The crew sailing in our Country have recently developed a very curious distraction. It is quite common for sailors to do some fishing while at sea to supply themselves with some extra food, but those accompanying Target Explorer have cultivated that to the point of devising a whole game around that activity.

They keep scores not only depending on the number of fish each one has captured, but also on their sizes, and even the exact type of fish. Different species grant different amounts of points, though not always the bigger fish is the most valuable. They keep a board on deck in which they track the score of each player, and do a full tally at the end of the week. The fisherman with the highest score will get preference when picking rations during the following week.

Despite being at sea a lot, it is not uncommon for sailors to not know how to swim, and on the contrary, they are usually quite familiar with the disgusting sight of drowned corpses. As such, the fear of drowning is almost ever-present in any sailor.

To be able to manage it, and considering that the beaches of our Country offer a prime opportunity for safe swimming practice, one of the crew members who knows how to swim has offered Target Explorer the possibility of organizing swimming lessons for the crew. Despite the obvious and expected delays in the progress of the expedition, those lessons would ensure the safety, at least of mind, of the crew.

As our ship approaches our Country, large numbers of gift-laden canoes start to follow it. The canoes' occupants have fearlessly boarded the vessel and two seemingly important fellows are trying to persuade our Country to follow them to Tribal Nation.

Their intentions seem innocent, and our translators can pick out that we have arrived just in time for some sort of local festival.

Our ship's mast formation, sails, and rigging resemble certain significant artifacts for the natives, and our clockwise route around the island mirrored the path that their processions take during this festival. This has convinced the natives that we are friendly—but one false move and it might change...

According to them, it is a high-pitched continuous melody, without any discernable words in it but unmistakably feminine in origin. They assure it is caused by sirens that are following the ship in hopes of luring the crew to their certain death. As such, they suggest getting back to port before they can get hold of the ship.

Once, the walls of Constantinople marked the center of the world. From there flowed law, faith, and imperial order, truly a legacy claimed from Rome herself. Now, that inheritance weighs heavily upon us.

Years of intrigue, hollow victories, and fraying authority have left the our Country diminished in spirit if not yet in name. Beyond our borders, new powers gather with patience and hunger, while within them old offices rot from neglect. Our people deserve a better way, to match the splendor and affluence of our glorious ancestors! / Word has arrived from Constantinople. It appears that the ancient Imperial seat is troubled, its authority fraying under the weight of discord and decline. For generations, the fate of the Target Location has shaped the order of the Christianity lands of the Balkans, binding our histories through faith, each sword keeping the other in the sheathe, for the most part.

Now, as its grip weakens, the balance that once governed our borders grows wearily uncertain. Some among our influential families urge caution, warning that the fall of such a pillar would unsettle all who share its rite. Others speak more bluntly: that old guarantees are fading, and that what was once settled by tradition may soon be decided by force. In these uneasy times, the course we choose will echo far beyond our own our Country. / Imperial weakness rarely announces itself with ceremony. The consecutive displays of weakness, inability to guard their borders and a loss of prestige in the Byzantium is a sign that their time in the sun is drawing to a rigid and sudden end. Thus, the situation to the west no longer demands reverence or caution — only calculation. It shall be us who feast on their remains and ascend to take their place.

The air is charged with reverence as our religious heads, clad in intricate feathered headdresses and vibrant ceremonial garbs, ignite the flames using only the friction of their divine tools. Witnesses hold their collective breath, knowing that the fate of our world rests on this sacred act.

The flames erupt, casting a warm, orange glow across the faces of our people. In this moment, we are united in our faith, bound by tradition, and connected to the cosmos. The ceremony reminds us of our eternal duty to maintain the cosmic order, and as we watch the fire dance against the darkening sky, we seek reassurance that our civilization will continue to thrive, by humbly offering our dues to our gods.

desc:
The Kebra Nagast, also known as The Glory of the Kings, is the national epic from our Country. It was written by Nebure Id Ishaq of Axum, under the supervision of bishop Abba Giyorgis. This work serves as a repository of our national and religious sentiments, carrying immense historical and cultural significance.

The text of the Kebra Nagast is believed to be centuries old and it holds a special place within our Country literature and culture, intricately weaving together history, religion, and the origins of the our Country dynasty, which holds great importance within the our Country Miaphysitism Church.

The Kebra Nagast unfolds the captivating account of the encounter between the Queen of Sheba and King Solomon. It also narrates the fascinating story of how their son, Menelik I (Menyelek), brought the revered Ark of the Covenant to Ethiopia. In addition to these remarkable tales, the epic explores the profound shift in religious beliefs among our people, as they transitioned from the worship of celestial bodies to embracing the faith in the Lord God of Israel.

Crafted from a single piece of metal, it is made of bronze and gold with its central cross featuring an elongated descending arm and gracefully flared ends, all adorned with intricate ornamentation. A distinctive characteristic of the Cross is the portrayal of Adam's arms at the base, adorned during festive occasions with vibrant and colorful pieces of cloth, adding to the cross's grandeur and significance.

desc:
The Fetha Negest, also known as the Justice of the Kings, is a theocratic legal code compiled around 1240 in Arabic by Abu'l-Fada'il ibn al-Assal, an Egyptian Christian writer. He drew his laws from apostolic writings and previous law codes of Byzantine rulers.

The textual history of the Fetha Negest reveals its two distinct parts. The first part primarily focuses on ecclesiastical matters, detailing the structure of the Church hierarchy and sacraments. It incorporates elements from the Bible, works of early Church fathers like St. Basil and St. Hippolytus, as well as canons established at councils such as the Council of Nicaea and the Council of Antioch.

The second part of the Fetha Negest addresses issues pertaining to the laity, including family law, debt, and civil administration. While drawing from the same sources as the first part, it is largely attributed to four books collectively known as the Canons of the Emperors. These books include the Procheiron (also known as Procheiros Nomos), the Arabic version of the Syro-Roman Law Book, the Arabic version of the Ecloga, and the Precepts of the Old Testament.

For centuries, the Fetha Negest has served as an authoritative legal guide for the Miaphysitism Christians of Egypt. It has now been translated to our Country in Ethiopia and expanded upon with additional local laws. Some judges in our realm wonder if we should adopt it and most among the our Country('clergy_estate') support this action.
entities.name: The Justice of the Kings

Rebuilding closer to Akershus will also allow us to properly fortify the city, which can be of great benefit in these times. This sacred day, traditionally observed on June 28th, marks the anniversary of the Battle of Kosovo and honors the martyrs and heroes who fought to preserve our nation's freedom.

When Vasa spreads it sails and makes its first gliding cut through the water, a great cheer rings throughout the harbor.

desc:
The Rialto bridge is one of the four bridges that cross the Grand Canal of our Country. It was originally a wooden bridge, but that first burned during a 1310 revolt and collapsed in both 1444 and 1524. The renewal of the Rialto bridge was first proposed in 1503, and the idea was to rebuild the bridge in stone. The authorities requested proposals in 1551 after several projects had been considered since 1503 and the following decades. Famous architects such as Jacopo Sansovino, Palladio and Vignola offered plans, but their proposals were deemed inappropriate to the situation as they all involved a Classical approach with several arches. The famous artist Michelangelo was also considered as designer of the Rialto bridge, but the submission by Antonio da Ponte eventually defeated others, thanks to its audacious single-span design.

What shall we do?

Our decision to limit the reconstruction efforts following the devastating natural disaster has had dire consequences. Venice remains largely in ruins, with many buildings still in disrepair and streets filled with debris. The lack of adequate restoration and sanitation has created a breeding ground for disease and pest infestations, threatening the health and wellbeing of our citizens.

The filthy conditions and lingering destruction have led to outbreaks of illness, with plagues and pestilence spreading rapidly through the population. The Target Location's reputation and morale have suffered greatly, and urgent action is now required to address this worsening crisis. We must reconsider our approach and invest in comprehensive clean-up and restoration efforts to restore health, order, and prosperity.

Some argue that maintaining direct control over Jerusalem under the rule of the our Country would ensure our influence and protect the holy Target Location's sanctity. Others propose reestablishing Jerusalem, creating a vassal state that could rule the region while serving our interests and honoring the legacy of the Crusades.

The construction of the Doge's Palace in Venice began in the 9th century and continued throughout the subsequent centuries. Originally conceived as a fortress-like edifice, the palace evolved over time into a magnificent representation of Gothic architecture. This architectural marvel serves the dual purpose of being both the residence of the our Country, the preeminent political leader of the Venice and housing various government offices and courts.

Over the time, however, the building has grown visibly old and in a need of renovation. Perhaps, we should consider turning it into a palace that would dwarf even the royal residences of Western kings.

Boasting a strategic location, this maritime complex plays a vital role in the city's maritime prowess. From thriving shipbuilding activities to the innovation and pioneering of vessel armaments, this is the backbone that ensures our dominance at sea.

options.name: Magnificent!

From frescos to statues and a myriad of upcoming artists who wish to stand on the shoulders of giants and make a name for themselves. The latest such jewel to adorn our capital is none other than the minor basilica of San Zanipolo. Its large brick edifice is designed in the gothic style and the grounds serve as the primary Dominican church of our great people. The work is dedicated to John and Paul, two legendary martyrs whose presence was first cataloged around the 4th century.

desc: When the Rome, with the intent of crushing the Albigensian and Patarinian heresies, endeavored to establish everywhere in Italy the Dominican Inquisition, the our Country resisted its introduction into our Country. The State charged itself to discover heretics, who when caught were examined by the Patriarch, the Bishop of Castello, or any other our Country Ordinary. The examining Court was confined to a return of fact. It was called on to state whether the examinee was or was not guilty of heresy. Punishment was reserved for the secular authority. This arrangement did not satisfy the Court of Rome, an Inquisitor was appointed by the Rome, but he required the our Country's exequatur before he could act and a board was created of three our Country nobles, to sit as assessors to the Holy Office. Their duty was to guard the rights of our Country citizens against ecclesiastical encroachment, including the non-interference in religious matters within the colonies, without their presence and their sanction no act of the Holy Office was valid in our Country. The Inquisition in our Country was certainly no sanguinary Office, thanks no doubt in a large degree to the independent attitude of the State, which insisted upon the presence of lay assessors at every trial.
entities.name: The Dominican Inquisition

Our tradition spurs from a love and adoration of the water which serves as both our path to greatness and the primary defense of our great capital, in our Country. Now that our navy is the uncontested hegemon of the Mediterranean, let us proclaim the sea as Mare Nostrum - our sea!

Renowned for his adept handling of color and groundbreaking brushwork techniques, his artistic journey spans over seven decades. Throughout this extensive period, he has crafted an extensive array of works encompassing portraits, mythological narratives, and religious compositions.

Notable among his portraits, such as 'Venus of Urbino,' is the acclaim they receive for their profound psychological depth and opulent color schemes. Target Character's impact on the evolution of both our Country and European art is deep-seated, and his enduring legacy positions him as one of the foremost painters of the Renaissance.

These artists excel in capturing the essence of their subjects through vibrant palettes and striking chiaroscuro techniques, which lend their creations an unparalleled sense of realism. Portraiture is a central theme, with artists achieving remarkable character portrayals. Additionally, allegorical and mythological subjects have become popular, showcasing our Country art's diverse range and emotional resonance.

Due to our current status as major trading hub in Europe, we can accumulate considerable wealth, and this prosperity fuels the extravagance of the Carnival. It has become a symbol of our opulence and decadence, attracting visitors from all over Europe who are eager to participate in the masked festivities. The masks worn during the Carnival not only provide anonymity but also serve as a way to erase social distinctions, allowing people from different backgrounds to mingle freely during the celebrations.

This covert group is marked by its use of subterfuges like paradox and allegory to avoid criticism. Operating discreetly, members often employ secret language and publish anonymously, with their philosophy influenced by Aristotelian naturalism from the University of Padova.

This clandestine academy, despite facing censorship and finding its works on the Index, boldly challenges societal norms through satirical compositions and hybrid genres. Shaped by the ideologies of prominent thinkers, they critique tyranny in historical writings. Surprisingly, the Accademia degli Incogniti has become a key force in advancing musical theatre in Venice, establishing the Teatro Novissimo.

The Islam practiced by these 'Shirazis', as they call themselves, is, however, not the most orthodox form of the religion. Many older local ceremonies are performed daily in our our Country and the Shirazi lineages are considered to have magical abilities that give them the right to rule these cities.

As the wealth of Target Country2 and the other Swahili states grows, however, new waves of foreigners continue to arrive in great numbers. Traders from Oman, Persia, and other faraway lands have made our cities their home and a rising class of indigenous merchants has made these groups their partners.

Many of the newcomers are abhorred by our traditions. If we would adopt a more orthodox form of Islam this would certainly help our relations with the other states of the Indian Ocean Region, but there is a very real risk that it would undermine our own rule and hurt relations with the other Swahili states.

The world thought our age would pass like a wild storm gives way to clear skies. Yet here we are, sails still catching wind, the banner of the our Country still flying high. Merchants still whisper our names in fear, and navies still scramble to contain us. The so-called powers of the world failed to snuff us out, and in their failure, we have carved our legend across the waves of the seven seas. This is no longer the Golden Age Of Piracy. It is the beginning of a new era, under the sturdy guidance of Target Character. / The so-called Golden Age Of Piracy was supposed to burn itself out, a flash of rebellion and greed destined to collapse under the weight of its own chaos. However, the fires of this wretched movement still burn bright across the ports of the Target Pirate Country.

For decades, they consolidated their power under Target Character and Target Character predecessors, reaching the top of their pyramid of greed, thriving in the loot accumulated from their many voyages. Their ships are faster, their sailors hardened, and their captains bolder than ever. Trade convoys reroute in fear, coastal settlements reinforce their walls, and the navies of the world brace for more blood. The Target Pirate Country have prevailed.

From the humid coves of the Caribbean to the stormy waters of Africa, whispers spread of a rising tide of piracy, an age not of kings or crowns, but of sails, steel, and rum. A golden age of plundering, booze, and seafaring adventures.

These heavily fortified and mobile defensive structures allowed largely peasant infantry to repel the devastating cavalry charges of their better-equipped enemies. We had a dream that we knew was just but in the face of corruption and evil we faltered, alas it was not meant to be... / Our crusade against heresy has been crowned with divine success. The fires of Hussitism have been extinguished within Bohemia, and the righteous authority of Catholicism has been restored across the faithful lands. Let the world see that the Church's resolve is unbreakable. / The flames of the Hussitism movement have, in the end, given way to another reformed creed. The struggle that began over the chalice has carried Bohemia down a path none could have foreseen, and the Hussite Wars now draw to their close. / Despite the righteousness of our cause, the followers of Hussitism have prevailed in Target Capital. The Bohemia emerges from this conflict emboldened, their heretical faith recognized by all. We must accept this bitter peace and seek another path to restore the unity of Catholicism.

desc:
The transition from being part of the wider Roman Catholic Church to the local Church of our Country has generally worked well, but in some areas, such as Witch Location, it has become unclear where religious authority lies. When there was suspicion of witchcraft in the old days, the Catholic Church would often become involved and might temper the outrage of the local population. The Reformation, on the other hand, has done much to strengthen the belief in popular versions of Christianity outside of the Roman Church.

A number of women stand accused of witchcraft in our Country and a search has already begun to find more. Local priests and magistrates have become enmeshed in the trials, but so far the state has not been involved. As the number of women awaiting trial grows larger and larger, it may become necessary for us to act.

By encouraging people to 'buy American', they are pushing for more imports from the colonies, outcompeting our own goods and depriving good our Country people of work. We might profit from this influx of foreign trade, but the safest option would be to erect barriers to reduce it.

Once, Aksum was the heart of the ancient Aksumite Empire, a bastion of Christian power situated at the crossroads of Africa, Arabia, and the Greco-Roman world. Among the obelisks and palace ruins, we have rebuilt the churches of this mighty nation of old.

The greatest of them all is the Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion. It is the place where we crown our emperors, the descendants of Menelik I, who was the son of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. It is here that he brought the Ark of the Covenant. Every year, thousands of pilgrims come from the farthest reaches of our our Country and beyond to visit this holy place.

Perched atop a cliff by the mighty Nile, Qasr Ibrim remained a bastion of Christianity in Lower Nubia even as the rest of the region fell into darkness. Now them will utilize the city's great political and economic resources to spread the word of the one true God throughout Nubia!

desc: Deep in the Red Sea Mountains, in a hidden oasis, lies one of our most sacred places - the Monastery of Saint Anthony. Built by Anthony's followers in the 4th century, this Christian monastery is one of the oldest in the world. Saint Anthony, foremost of the Desert Fathers, is known as The Father of Monks. He ventured into the desert where he spent many years as a hermit, his life dedicated to God. During the Great Persecution, he went back to civilization to comfort the imprisoned, risking his life for his fellow Christians. At the end of his life, he settled by the oasis where the great monastery stands today. Thousands of pilgrims follow in Anthony's footsteps each year, and now that As-Suways is under our protection, we can ensure that they reach their destination safely.
entities.name: Monastery of Saint Anthony

desc: At the foot of the holy Mount Sinai, where Moses received the Ten Commandments, stands a monastery dedicated to Saint Catherine of Alexandria. Catherine was a devoted student and follower of Christ. When the Roman Emperor Maxentius began persecuting Christians, the brave young maiden reproached him for his cruelty. The emperor gathered fifty of his best philosophers and orators to debate with her, but wise Catherine won. Even though she was subsequently imprisoned and tortured, Maxentius failed yet again, as many of his closest subjects were converted by Catherine's eloquence and piousness. In his fury, the emperor sentenced Catherine to death on a breaking wheel, but it shattered at her touch. In the end, she was beheaded, although her martyrdom has helped spread the light of Christ to many godless hearts.

desc:
The monasteries of our our Country are famed as centers of learning and art. At each monastic school reside a number of religious scholars, experts within fields such as Church history, exegesis of the Holy Scripture, reading, grammar, poetry, music, calligraphy, and painting. The monasteries compete to attract the most learned masters and maintain them with great honor and monetary compensation. In return, the scholars pass on their knowledge to their students, which consist of potential clergymen as well as ambitious nobles. To join the Christian elite, being part of a powerful family is rarely enough - everyone who has a significant role in the running of our country has been educated at one of the most prestigious monastic schools.

We have been contacted by two of these schools and they are asking for our support. If we choose to offer our patronage, it could be beneficial for the scholarly development of the nation.

Rejoice, the holy city of Alexandria is once more under Miaphysitism rule! The historical seat of our sacred Church has been liberated.

Alexandria is an ancient and proud city, founded by Alexander 'the Great,'  and many of humanity's brightest minds have called her their home. For many hundreds of years, the scholars of Alexandria studied and taught at The Great Library, which was followed by the Catechetical School of Alexandria, first in the world of its kind. In the years to come, we will restore the sacred halls of knowledge and produce some of the finest theologians the world has ever known.

'I shall follow in the footsteps of Saint Shenoute the Archimandrite - one day I might even found a monastery of my own!' he exclaims passionately.
Not everyone would agree with this nobleman's decision, however, and even though he has already started giving away his belongings, there might still be time to talk the man out of going.

However, while we are firm in our convictions and will never abandon Christ, being isolated from the rest of the Christian community is a weakness. We are beset by religious enemies on many fronts. The impending war is not a matter of if, it is a matter of when. Before it breaks out, we should try to seek powerful allies. There is a mighty Christian realm far to the north, but its exact location and the distance to their lands are unknown to us. However, we can fund an expedition with the goal of finding it.

Our advisors suspect that they are trying to make contact with other Christians to the north. The diplomats are worryingly tight-lipped on the subject of their purpose. Perhaps it is simply a religious matter, but what if they are attempting to gather allies against us? We would be beset on multiple fronts by fanatical infidels!

They will neither be persuaded to let our people continue on their journey nor to return the diplomats back home. We can only hope that they change their minds. In any case, this outrageous attack on a party of peaceful envoys only confirms our suspicions: Muslim Neighbor is a dangerous enemy of the one true faith.

desc: Sometimes we are reminded of how far this world extends beyond our own realms. We have been visited by a strange group of people from lands far south of here. While most of them only speak their own peculiar-sounding language, a few of them have conversed with our translators in Arabic. They claim to come from the great Sent Diplomats of Sent Diplomats and that they seek friends among their fellow Christians. We have very little knowledge of the Christians in the south, but these Sent Diplomats men seem to be genuine believers. They speak of Christ with fervor and seem far more well-versed in the scripture than our own average noble. Apparently their country is surrounded by religious enemies, and they ask us to aid them in defending the true faith. While this conflict is too distant and unknown for us to become engaged directly, we could share some of our knowledge and resources with them.

desc: Praise the Lord, our diplomats have finally returned from their journey to the north! Not only are they with us again, safe and sound, but they also bring many interesting tomes and tales from their travels. Most come from the Faraway Catholic of Faraway Catholic, where our diplomats were very well received. While we might have hoped for more than knowledge, we are thankful for whatever God and our fellow Christians provide us with. We will make sure that their gift does not go to waste.

desc: After a long and arduous journey, the diplomats whom we sent northwards have finally returned. They did indeed reach Christian lands in the end, yet they came back empty-handed. While many of the Christians they encountered listened, few seemed to truly care. In our isolation, we are doubly cursed. Not only are we surrounded by enemies, but the distance to the rest of the Christian community makes us outcasts. What happens in our Country does not influence them and perhaps our ways are too foreign for them to relate to. It seems as if the Miaphysites are alone in the world.

Rejoice, the holy city of Alexandria is once more under Miaphysitism rule! The historical seat of our sacred Church has been liberated by them.

Alexandria is an ancient and proud city, founded by Alexander 'the Great,' and many of humanity's brightest minds have called her their home. For many hundreds of years, the scholars of Alexandria studied and taught at The Great Library, which was followed by the Catechetical School of Alexandria, first in the world of its kind. In the years to come, her sacred halls of knowledge will be restored and will come to produce some of the finest theologians the world has ever known.
entities.name: The Pearl of the Mediterranean

options.name: We will make Game Concept Target Location great again!

desc: Finally, we are free once more, and Target Location has been liberated along with our sacred Etchmiadzin Cathedral! This cathedral is the shelter of our people, our safe haven through hard times. During our people's stateless years, Etchmiadzin remained our national and political center. Throughout centuries of war and loss, we have found strength and the will to keep on fighting in her loving embrace, and now we can finally repay our mother by restoring her to her former glory.
entities.name: The Heart of Armenia

options.name: The true faith grows ever stronger!

For many years, the cathedral has been the national and political center of the stateless Armenian people. Throughout centuries of war and loss, they have found strength and the will to keep on fighting in her loving embrace. Now she will be restored to her former glory!
entities.name: The Heart of Armenia

options.name: O Lord, bless this city, in thy mercy!

desc: The ancient city of Antioch is now part of our Holy our Country! Antioch was a center of early Christianity during the time of the Romans. The Jews who were converted here by the apostle Peter were the first to be called Christians. A great number of monasteries were founded here during that time. Since then, Antioch has seen many wars and known many masters. In the 13th century, the city fell to the Mamālīk and its entire Christian population was put to the sword. In honor of their sacrifice, we will rebuild Antioch and its monasteries, making it more glorious than ever!
entities.name: The Cradle of Christianity

Perched atop a cliff by the mighty Nile, Qasr Ibrim remained a bastion of Christianity in Lower Nubia even as the rest of the region fell into darkness. This new addition to our our Country does not only hold religious importance, however, as it is also a center of trade and politics. With these resources in our hands, our Country will grow even stronger!

desc:
It has been so long since Crusader boots set foot in the Holy Land. Our knights, resolute and unwavering, have concluded a most prestigious campaign, the reclamation of the ancient city of Antioch. This storied city, perched on the shores of the Mediterranean, stands as a testament to centuries of diverse cultures and turbulent history. Its narrow, winding streets whisper tales of empires risen and fallen, from the Seleucids to the Byzantines. Antioch's strategic importance is unwavering, as it guards the eastern gateway to the Mediterranean and is a vital hub for trade and military control.

As a Military Order, we are driven by our relentless dedication to the defense of Christianity, determined to restore the city to its rightful hands. In the present moment, under the clear Syrian skies, our men march forth, their crimson cross banners fluttering in the wind, resolute in their quest to reclaim the rest of the Holy Land from the clutches of time, heathens and turmoil.
entities.name: The Conquest of Antioch

effects: Add Government Power: Government Power Mild Bonus
options.name: Let it not fall to heathen hands again!

desc:
Our elders do not recall the last time they laid their eyes on such a beautiful city. Urfa, under the command of Crusaders, embodies the fervor and resilience of our order. Nestled amidst the arid plains of Mesopotamia, it boasts a rich history that resonates with the echoes of the First Crusade, as the first Crusader state established in the East. Our predecessors had fortified its walls and woven a tapestry of Christian devotion into the very fabric of this ancient land. Its streets bear the scars of countless battles, yet they remain a testament to the enduring spirit of our forefathers.

Today, we stand united, driven by our unwavering commitment to protect the city from the encroaching forces that threaten our Christian brethren. Under the blazing sun, our crimson cross banners rise high as we advance, determined to restore the entire region to its rightful place in the annals of Crusader history.
entities.name: The Conquest of Urfa

effects: Add Government Power: Government Power Extreme Bonus

desc:
One of the most prized cities in the Levant, Damascus now lays under Crusader command as she stands, a jewel in the heart of the Holy Land. Its ancient walls and bustling bazaars reflect the legacy of both Islamic and Christian rule. Under our watchful eye, Damascus shall thrive as a beacon of of our great victory and mercy, where Christian and Muslim communities coexist in relative harmony.

Against those who wish to see the city in heathen hands, we will raise our sword and protect it and its inhabitants, lest they besmirch the legacy of this magnificent settlement. Our resolve is unwavering, our faith steadfast, as we march forth with crimson crosses emblazoned on our armor, determined to safeguard this bastion of Christian influence and ensure that the vibrant history of Damascus continues to flourish under Crusader rule.
entities.name: The Conquest of Damascus

options.name: Let it be our new capital!

desc:
Many across the halls of Catholicism nations have voiced their concerns in our ability to retake the Holy Land's most prized city, Jerusalem. Let our victory silence all these voices as the momentous task of reclaiming this revered city is proclaimed an absolute success. Under our command, the city shall blossom into a testament of Christian devotion, a place where history and faith intertwine. Its majestic ramparts encircle a city imbued with sacred significance, where the echoes of Christ's footsteps reverberate through the cobblestone streets.

Within these ancient walls, the grandeur of the Church of the Holy Sepulchre stands as a beacon of unwavering faith, drawing pilgrims from all corners of the world. Yet, the great peril never ceases, as hostile forces seek to extinguish the Christian presence within these cherished confines. With unwavering resolve and the emblematic crimson cross etched upon our armor, we advance, bound by a solemn duty to protect the heart of Christendom and ensure that Jerusalem remains a timeless symbol of Christian reverence for generations to come.
entities.name: The Conquest of Jerusalem

Its vibrant cities, like Jerusalem and Antioch, thrive as bustling centers of commerce and culture, where diverse communities coexist, forging a unique tapestry of religious tolerance. Within these walls, cathedrals and fortresses bear witness to our enduring faith, with every stone a testament to our unshaken dedication.

However, the specter of adversity looms large, as hostile forces threaten to unravel the very fabric of what we have accomplished. Our successive victories across the Levant have left many heathens frozen in terror, as our banners approach their borders, eager to restore what is rightfully ours.

Drawing on Plato, Plotinus, and Proclus, these thinkers are careful to note the parallels with Christianity. The One, they say, is not so different from God: eternal, beyond all predication, the source of all being.

The future of the land lies in the hand of the children, and, to be able to trust them with our our Country's future, it is best to educate them and make sure their knowledge of the world will never fail them.

The small or large rock will fall to the Earth along the path of a line that is perpendicular to the plane (saṭḥ) of the horizon, this is witnessed by experience (tajriba). This point moves with the motion of the Earth and thus there will be no difference in place of fall of the two rocks.

Birjandi has written many books, and Birjandi knowledge and skill should be of great use for our our Country.

desc: Every able-bodied Islam man and woman who can afford to go on Ḥajj is required to do so at least once to fulfill a religious duty and one of the Five Pillars of Islam. It is a pilgrimage to Mecca where all male pilgrims dress in the 'iḥrām, to show equality of all pilgrims in front of our Country as there is no difference between a prince and a pauper. The pilgrims do not shave, clip their nails, wear perfume, swear or quarrel, have sexual relations, uproot or damage plants, kill or harm wild animals, cover the head or the face and hands, marry, wear shoes over the ankles, or carry weapons. As the ruler of the our Country and an able-bodied Islam Target Ruler, it is time for Target Ruler to set an example and begin the Ḥajj.

desc: The many rituals of Ḥajj include Ṭawāf, where the pilgrims visit the Ka'ba and walk around it seven times counter-clockwise uttering a prayer in each circuit, ending the ritual by praying and running or walking seven times between the hills of āl-Ṣafā wāl-Marwa. The next day the pilgrims leave for Mount 'Arafāt, where they stand in contemplative vigil and pray and recite the Qur'ān. The night is spent sleeping on the ground of Muzdalifa. The day after, the pilgrims throw stones to signify their defiance of šayṭān at the largest pillar known as Jamrāt'al'Aqabah. When the seven stones have been thrown, the pilgrims slaughter animals to commemorate the story of 'Ibrāhīm and 'Ismā'īl. The pilgrimage is almost over, but some tasks still remain.
entities.name: The Rituals of Ḥajj

Some pilgrims travel to the city of Medina and the Al-Masjid al-Nabawī, which contains the tomb of Prophet Muḥammad, peace be upon him.

The Ātlcāhualo, meaning means 'Ceasing of Water', is the first festival of the year and it is dedicated to Tlāloc, the God of the Rain and other related rain deities. In it, our people implore the God to bring the rain as they enter the driest months of the year.

During this period, offerings of maize and sacrifices of children are made to Tlāloc. These children who will serve as sacrifices are dressed ritually and brought to several sacred mountains by the priests, while people cry at the sight of the procession. They receive the nickname of Tlācatetehuit or 'Human Stripes', in analogy to the paper stripes called Āmatetehuitl that the priests carry with them.

Before being sacrificed, the children spend the night on the summit of the mountain, where they are not allowed to sleep. Their cries in the night are seen as a good omen that the rain will soon come. / During The second month in our solar calendar, the Festival of Tlācaxīpēhualiztli or of 'The Flaying of Men' is dedicated to Xīpe Totēc. The cycle of life, death, and rebirth is his domain and so is deadly warfare. During this month, our people celebrate the coming of spring and fertility, the rebirth of life.

In his honor, the captives are flayed and sacrificed and their skins are worn for twenty days. Gladiatoral sacrifices are also done, where captives are given a mock weapon and made to fight to the death against a number of our most valiant A Jaguar Warrior. Should they prevail, they are given freedom back. / During the celebration of the Festival of Tōzōztōntli or the 'Little Vigil', planting and sowing are celebrated. Despite the festival being celebrated mainly in honor of Tlāloc, other gods and goddesses of maize and fertility are also worshipped, such as Cōātlīcue. During this festival, children are brought to nature, and they are pierced to let out blood, while some of them are also sacrificed to Tlāloc in caves. There, the flailed skins worn since Tlācaxīpēhualiztli are finally taken off and buried. / Today we celebrate the Festival of the 'Great Vigil' or Huēyi Tōzōztli in honor of the God Centeōtl, the deity of the Maize. We give thanks to the maize as it feeds us, and we honor the harvest we get from it.

This month of the 'Great Vigil' we sacrifice children in the names of Tlāloc and all the deities of the maize, as Tlāloc should also be thanked for the rain he provided us and made this harvest possible. / The Festival of Toxcatl, meaning 'drought', is celebrated as the fifth month of the year and revolves around renewal. This festivity is dedicated to the Gods Tēzcatlipōca and Huītzilōpōchtli, and offerings of food and flowers are made to them. The climax of the festival, however, is the sacrifice of the man who has been representing Tēzcatlipōca during the past full year.

This young man to be sacrificed is always selected among captives, and for a year he is taught how to behave, learning language, songs, and to play the flute. For the whole year, he is treated with reverence among our people, as he is the impersonation of Tēzcatlipōca himself, but during Toxcatl he is sacrificed, flayed, and eaten by the our Country('nobles_estate'). The one to impersonate Tēzcatlipōca next year is immediately chosen afterward so that the cycle can continue. / The sixth month of the year is called Etzalcualiztli, or 'Eating of Fresh Maize. It is dedicated to the Gods Tlāloc and Chālchiuhtlicue, and in it, we celebrate young crops and the end of the dry season.

During Etzalcualiztli, our main temple is adorned with rushes and paper of colors put around the necks of the statues of the Gods like a necklace. To Gods are asked for rain to put an end to the dry season, and pilgrimages are made to the top of Tlāloc mountain, where both children and adults are sacrificed. / 'The Small Festival of the Gods', or Tēcuilhuitōntli, is celebrated in honor of Huīxtohcihuātl, Goddess of salt and salt water, and sister of Tlāloc. During this month, people thank the Gods for the arrival of water and the healthy growth of the crops, while the city is decorated with water flowers.

As in other festivals, during this month a woman personifies the Goddess and other women dance around her during the ceremonies, wearing yellow flowers. After the conclusion of the ceremony, the one representing Huīxtohcihuātl is ritually sacrificed. / We are celebrating the Huēyi Tēcuilhuitōntli which is the 'Great Festival of the Gods'. The Maize Gods, in particular the Goddess Chicōmecōātl, are honored with dances and the lords feed the commoners as we celebrate abundance.

During this month, slave women, representing the Goddesses Chicōmecōātl y Cihuacōātl are sacrificed. The one that represents Chicōmecōātl is brought to the summit of a mountain and then she and the midwives that accompany her during the celebration run back to the temple to pray. There, she has to dance in the temple, after which she is sacrificed. / The ninth month of the year is dedicated to the dead and is celebrated by our traders. This month, called Tlaxōchimaco or 'Giving Flowers', is themed around flowers and trade.

The month is filled with celebrations honoring our dead, and our traders celebrate their year-long success. The God Huītzilōpōchtli is honored during this month, with offerings of flowers and food for him first before the rest of the Gods. Noble women receive the xocotl, meaning 'fruit', which is a thick log that is then erected in our main temple.

Celebrations include the offering of flowers and food to the ancestors, as well as sacrifices of children and an impersonator of Mictlāntēcutli, God of the Dead. / The main feast of the dead is celebrated during the Festival of Xocotl Huetzi, meaning 'Fall of Fruits', where fruits and harvest are celebrated.

The Gods Huēhuehteōtl and Xiuhtēcuhtli are honored and throughout this month, people climb to the roofs of their houses and invite their dead to come back. The xocotl erected in the previous month is taken down and put on top of a log adorned with paper strips.

The last day of this month, captives are thrown to the fires and then priests rip their hearts out. In the end, youngsters try to climb the log using ropes to be honored, after which the log is chopped down. / During the month of 'Sweeping,' or Ochpāniztli, we celebrate the harvest and cleansing. Several Gods are honored all along these twenty days, such as Tlahzolteōtl, Toci (also called Cōātlīcue or Tēteoh īnnān), or Centeōtl.In this month, people ritually sweep and bathe as part of the celebrations, and a representative of the Goddess Toci is sacrificed.

The slave representing Toci is ignored during the first five days of the month, then silently danced around during the following eight. Finally, during the last five days, the midwives and healers who bought the slave for the ceremony fake battles against the slave to distract her. On the night of the last day, the slave is brought to the temple, and a priest carries her after she spreads Maize flour on the floor. A second priest then cuts her head off, and her body is flayed. The priest then wears the skin as a representation of the new and reborn Toci. A piece of the skin of the leg is then used to create a mask. / 'The Gods Arrive' or Teōtlehco is the twelfth month of our calendar, and the Arrival of the Gods is celebrated, and All Gods are honored during this month.

In the temple, Maize flour is put on a plate, and a priest checks periodically if it has footprints on it. If there are, the Gods have arrived, and wind instruments are played and people offer balls of maize.

After the Gods' arrival, captives are thrown into the fires and before they die they are taken out of it, their hearts are ripped out and they are beheaded. These captives, representing the mīmixcōah, become stars in the sky after this celebration.

Great quantities of pulque are drunk as the month goes on in honor of Ōmetōchtli, the various Gods of pulque. / The thirteenth month is the Festival of Tepēilhuitl or 'the Mountain Feast', dedicated to the mountains Tlāloc, Popōcatepētl, and Iztaccihuatl. All along this month, we honor the Gods of trade, but also Tlāloc and Xōchiquetzal.

Our people create a procession following the priests hiking to the nearest summits. In the temples erected on those summits, called Āyauhcalli or 'Mist Houses,' the devotees leave their offerings to the Gods, and people feast until dusk in the mountains 'between clouds.'

Among the sacrifices, children are given to Tlāloc as is custom, and a representation of Xōchiquetzal is also sacrificed to the Gods. / In The Festival of Quechōlli, or 'Roseate Spoonbill,' hunting is the main theme, and the month is dedicated to the God Mixcōhuātl, the Cloud Serpent God of the hunt. It is during these dry months that hunting becomes an important part of our culture.

As part of the celebrations, ritual hunting is carried out, as well as sacrifices of slaves and captives. It is also the month where we replenish our armories and new weapons are made. All the participants in these celebrations practice bloodletting to honor the animals that we will hunt, giving blood for blood, or our people dead in battles. / The Festival of Panquetzaliztli, or 'Raising of Banners,' is the fifteenth month of our calendar and marks the birth of Huītzilōpōchtli.

During this month, there is a big festival celebrating the birth of the God, at the end of which several slaves and captives are sacrificed, and whose owners abstain from almost eating until the month is over. As it is a martial-oriented month, ritual battles are fought.

A figure representing the God is also created with Maize that is eaten after the sacrifices. Throughout the month, there is a significant consumption of pulque, and people offer their blood to the God as a sacrifice. / This is the sixteenth month of the year or Ātemoztli, which means 'Descent of Water', and is devoted to Tlāloc, the God of Rain.

During this month, we pray for adequate rain to nourish our fields and ensure a bountiful harvest, while effigies of the God made with Maize dough are consumed. As a sacrifice, besides captives and slaves, children are drowned in the lake or the mountains as offerings. / As the year approaches its end, we celebrate the Festival of Tititl, 'Stretching.' This festivity honors Cihuacōātl, and during it, the Goddess is called Ilamahtēuctli, or 'the Old Woman,' as the Earth has dried out, and she is the fertile mother of us all.

In the ceremony, a representation of the Goddess made of amaranth is ritualistically sacrificed. As she dries, she becomes masculine, displaying the dualistic nature of the world.

Old people enjoy this month dedicated in many ways to them, but everyone dances and participates in fertility rituals. Merchants will also sacrifice slaves bought specifically for this celebration. / The last month of the year, 'Rebirth,' or Izcalli, marks the end of our calendar, just before the feared Nēmontēmi days. These days are dedicated to the Gods Tlāloc and Xiuhtēcuhtli, in hopes that they bring the fertility our fields need to feed our people.

During the Festival, tamales made of amaranth are profusely consumed, and youngsters go hunting beasts in the forests or birds in the lake, while the fires in the temples and homes are extinguished. These fires will only be reignited in the presence of the Deity. As with all festivities, sacrifices of slaves and captives dressed as the deities are performed. / We are in the last five days of the year, collectively known as the Nēmontēmi. During these days, our people do not celebrate anything as they are considered unlucky days; no business is conducted, and people practice abstinence as a sign of respect to the Tzitzimime.

While during the rest of the year, our people worship them as the protectresses of the feminine and progenitresses of mankind, during the days of the Nēmontēmi, as an unstable period of the year, they are feared.

Regardless, Target Character, has dared to host a celebration. Attendance at the event has been minimal, as most people fear a catastrophe or, at the very least, that attending such a festivity during the unlucky days could bring bad luck to them and their families. Despite the advice of our our Country('clergy_estate'), our our Country has turned a deaf ear and proceeded with the preparations. Will the deities punish us?

On one side of the argument, there is the idea that God's work should be based on contemplation, regardless of the ebbs and flows of popular opinion. This view is shared by many of the most senior members of the our Country('clergy_estate'), which hold that the our Country should not alter his judgment to cater to those concerned only with earthly rewards, regardless of how much earthly power they might hold.

On the other side stand those that have gained their support mainly from the most influential and rich families among the our Country('burghers_estate'), arguing that a our Country that completely disregards the concerns and interests of the people is a failure as God's shepherd, and that having the support of the people can only bring but benefits.

The position of Our Country has unique jurisdiction and accountability within our our Country. Elected by the crew, he is expected to be their representative and to champion their needs against the often arbitrary authority of the captain.

Two candidates immediately present themselves. Target Character 1 is a true advocate for the crew; Target Character 1 has both the humility to listen to their concerns and the fortitude to stand up to the captain. Meanwhile, Target Character 2 is firmly in any captain's pocket; Target Character 2 is skilled at manipulating the crew into believing that our wishes are also their own. Who will win the hearts and minds of the assembled pirates?

As luck would have it, they had lost their letter of marque, proving they work with our approval, and whatever proof connects them to us is purely circumstantial.

Target Location, a once-thriving city, dressed with grand temples and bustling markets, now witnesses its doom. The heavens themselves seem to weep as torrential rains pour down upon the sacred metropolis, filling its streets with a relentless flood.

Thunder roars like the angered voice of Huītzilōpōchtli, while flames devour buildings like the wrathful fire of Xiuhtēcuhtli. The ground trembles beneath the feet of the terrified inhabitants, as if Tlaloc demands retribution. Target Location's end feels like a dreadful curse from the gods, a final judgment that obliterates our once-mighty people and leaves us in ruins.

desc:
In the heart of Target Location, the grand temple of Huītzilōpōchtli stands tall and revered, a symbol of our devotion to the gods. But one fateful day, a strange omen casts a shadow over the city. A streak of fire ignites the sky, blazing brilliantly in broad daylight, its origin in the distant western horizon. As if guided by divine hands, the fiery streak splits into three, each fragment trailing sparks of untamed energy. Panic has gripped out people as they witness this celestial spectacle, fearing it to be an ominous sign from Huītzilōpōchtli himself.

Whispers spread through the streets, tales of impending doom as the temple's sacred flames flicker uncertainly. desc:
Beneath the serene moonlight, a sorrowful sound emerges, sending shivers through the streets in Target Location. Night after night, a woman's voice pierces the darkness, her cries filled with an urgent plea for action. She beseeches them, saying, 'My children, we must leave,' and, 'My children, where will you go?' These haunting phrases echo relentlessly, evoking fear and bewilderment among the people who question our meddling and attempts to reform our society, as if the gods themselves indicate their displeasure. Driven by both curiosity and dread, they gather to decipher the mysterious voice's message, grappling with the enigmatic origin of this spectral presence, a voice unlike any they have heard before.

As the nights continue, the cries persist, growing increasingly intense and desperate, convincing them that this is a divine message, an ominous prophecy that cannot be ignored. Their destiny becomes intertwined with the haunting calls, forcing them to confront a critical decision: to follow the spectral woman's urging and embark on an uncertain journey, or to remain in their homeland, facing the shadow of impending doom that looms in the night.

desc:
In the wetlands surrounding Target Location, a skilled hunter's net ensnared a curious gray bird, its feathers resembling the somber hues of an overcast sky. This avian marvel bore a distinctive feature: a dark, mirror-like adornment nestled upon its forehead. When the hunters dared to peer into this magical mirror, astonishment overcame them as they witnessed the stars and the boundless expanse of the night sky reflected within.

Acknowledging the profound significance of this cryptic discovery, the bird was presented to our Country. As our Country gazed into the mirror, an enchanting spectacle unfolded before his eyes. our Country witnessed a multitude of warriors astride magnificent creatures reminiscent of colossal deer, a sight both perplexing and captivating. Determined to decipher the hidden meaning behind this mystical encounter, our Country entrusted the bird and its mirror to the revered high priests, with the solemn task of unraveling this celestial enigma.

Yet, as the high priests took turns peering into the mirror, their earnest efforts yielded only frustration and bewilderment. To their dismay, the mirror remained stubbornly vacant, withholding the celestial vision that had enthralled their leader. Despite their profound wisdom and unwavering devotion, the high priests found themselves incapable of offering counsel or unraveling the enigma that had seized the imagination of our Country, attributing it to a bad omen associated with the radical reforms that have recently gripped our people.

desc:
The ancient road connecting Konya, Erzurum, Sivas, and Tabriz has long been a lifeline for trade and dominance across Anatolia. Stretching through rugged terrain and fertile plains alike, this trunk road has facilitated the flow of goods, ideas, and armies for centuries. Its strategic importance cannot be overstated, as our advisors urge us to control all vital points across it.

As caravans laden with many goods and other treasures traverse this route, the road continues to bind the region together, shaping the destiny of empires. While the previous century saw the construction of key infrastructure across the road's eastern part, the expansion of the road network will only serve to cultivate the wealth of our people, once it lays firmly within our grasp.

desc: Konya and Sivas are each home to a vital Seljuk Mint. A great symbol of wealth and power, their workshops humming with the rhythmic strikes of hammers shaping valuable ore into coins that flow across the region. The iconic lion and sun motif adorning these coins speaks of strength, sovereignty, and the celestial forces believed to guide rulers and their realms. Strategically placed at the heart of Anatolia, these mints are more than mere places of commerce — they are tools of control, their currency binding distant provinces to the will of those who command them. To hold these mints is to wield economic dominance, fund armies, and project authority, making them a cornerstone of any ambition to rule the region.

Yet, the tides of change are relentless. The decline of the Seljuk Sultanate and the aftermath of Mongol invasions have driven waves of Turkic migrants westward, seeking new lands and opportunities. These settlers will look to our great our Country for protection and leadership.

Seeing an opportunity to reshape the region, we should encourage these migrations, repopulating the coasts of Anatolia and securing our rule over these lands. With each new settlement, the fabric of the region shifts, transforming it into the heartland of our growing our Country. This Turkic presence strengthens our military and administration, ensuring that the foundations of our state rest firmly upon a loyal people that share our roots.

The reality of our situation places us in a precarious position. Our failed attempt to ascend now opens the door for instability under the ever-watchful eye of our rivals. Only time will tell if we are meant to survive or become a footnote in the books of history.

Unlike the calling to the battlefields of land, a matter of duty and search for glory, the sea calls to many free spirits who care little for such things. Stories of sailing the oceans of the world and the past expeditions of the our Country fleet are retold by old sailors as adventures, many of the great sights remembered, many of the great sacrifices forgotten.

Is it any wonder, with such a legacy, that the youths of our Country yearn for the vastness of the sea? Many more have come to join our navy over the past year. Some may end their lives at the bottom of the ocean, but those who return are sure to keep the stories alive.
