Many join the ranks of our navy expecting a more exciting life awaiting them with this opportunity to leave their home behind and see sea and land beyond the our Country borders. Not all of these are prepared for an often harsh and even more often dull and boring life at sea. Stuck with endlessly repetitive tasks, food and company on longer journeys, many young sailors quickly regret their decision.

Dismissed as daydreaming landlubbers by their more seasoned crewmates, they quickly become more trouble than they're worth. Some might eventually grow used to the reality of the job and become useful, but others do more good returning home.

As a result, the navy has begun to encourage those willing to risk their life at sea to aid our ailing land troops instead. After all, if there's no one to protect our ports, even our best ships and crews will have nowhere to dock.

An upstart preacher has begun spreading an apocalyptic message among our people. His fiery sermons denounce our corrupt, morally decayed society, especially those at the top. These ravings are causing quite a stir among our population — clearly, this madman has great powers of influence...

A proposition has come to us to invite this preacher, Flo Savonarola, to our Country, arguing that we could gain much from his presence in the city. At the very least, we would be sure to benefit from the pull his words have among the masses.

desc:
The zealousness of Flo Savonarola has reached unprecedented levels. His accusations against the Church have gone way beyond simple veiled attacks and instead turned into openly expressed defamation. His latest publications have also become more radical, trying to refute the accusations of heresy in them. He even started making allegations about his ability to perform miracles, which would undoubtedly show that he is being guided by God if they were true. To prove these alleged miracles, he was challenged to pass the trial of fire, a test in which he would have to walk through burning fire. If he is indeed capable of miracles and guided by God, fire would not be able to burn him and he would pass through it unscathed.

On the date assigned for the trial, a huge crowd assembled in the main square, eager to see the outcome. Expectation and nervousness could be felt in the air, and as time went on without anything starting the mood of the crowd went increasingly sour. Finally, the whole trial had to be canceled due to sudden rainfall, and people had to return home angry, blaming Savonarola for the failed test.

Whether they agreed with his preachings or not, it is undeniable that he left an impact on all the people of the our Country. His passing marks the end of all the agitation he caused, and albeit many of his followers are still spreading the same message, they do not represent the same force of change he was.

One such group of people is the Medici Dynasty family. Previously one of the most influential families that led the government of our Country, they saw themselves displaced when Savonarola took control.

However, his constant disagreements with the Rome paired with his ever-increasing overzealousness have strained their relations to an alarming degree.

He tried to maintain the division from tearing even further by sending letters to the Rome, but those attempts have eventually proved to be unsuccessful. Rome Rome has finally decided to summon him to Rome to end this debate once and for all.

Zealous priests are constantly eager to condemn excesses and vice, and to prove their point they are not afraid to put up a show as spectacularly as possible. The burning of cosmetics, mirrors, dresses and anything deemed susceptible to tempt people into sin is one of the most noticeable ways they have to condemn vanity. Those items are in constant danger of falling victim to the cleansing fire of the faith.

Flo Savonarola has taken it into his hands to make one such bonfire to rid the good people of our Country of sin. A huge bonfire will be set in the main square of our Country, and an example will be set for all to follow.

We are not the only ones who have noticed this, and it is quite likely that this great war of the Ōnin period will result in a prolonged period of strife and warfare between the different Japanese states. / The Japanese Shogunate has proved to be unable to manage the clans. The gradual lenience and delegation of authority towards the local rulers has become the Shogunate's downfall, and the many conflicts that have been brewing for centuries are now in the open. Villagers see it as the right and duty of the community to manage the land, but the our Country('nobles_estate') see this as little more than a convenient subversion of authority. There is no doubt that the reforms are working, but allowing these councils to operate calls into question the righteousness of the land owners and their original division of land.

our Country('peasants_estate') like this form of justice, but many urbanites and scholars cast doubt over the fairness of a judgment handled by non-professionals. Should the state allow this to continue?

Months and years had been spent underneath these unwavering stars, our lambs the only animal who would feed our wandering mouths, dust the only trail of life that we could follow.

And then something stopped. Our livestock started to fall one by one, their harmless backs turned to the ground like a carpet in our tents. Words were quickly spread about curses, spells, hexes.

The only certain thing is that death took what belonged to life. Without our livestock's meat, our people will soon follow their fate. We could try to remediate the issue by appealing to our diplomatic contacts, or by securing 'alternative' sources of meat from other lands.
